title: preactConfig
summary: Shared Vite resolution settings for Preact application builds.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: A UserConfig object; merge it with your configuration if not using applicationPlugins.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Aliases React-compatible library imports to Preact and deduplicates Preact. It also supplies SSR and dependency optimization settings.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Shared Vite resolution settings for Preact application builds.
sections.code: export default mergeConfig(preactConfig, { build: { manifest: true } });

sections.title: Behavior and limits
sections.body: applicationPlugins applies these settings automatically. The configuration belongs in Vite, not a browser entry.
